item.title: [Tamil Guardian - Tamil Affairs] Gotabaya Rajapaksa claims he does not remember the abductions of journalists
item.description:
Gotabaya Rajapaksa claims he does not remember the abductions of journalists
by Thusi test
Sat, 28/11/2026 - 08:57
Body
Lawyers speak outside the Jaffna Magistrate’s Court after Friday’s hearing.
Former Sri Lankan president Gotabaya Rajapaksa told the Jaffna Magistrate’s Court on Friday that he did not know journalist Keith Noyahr had been held at a secret location in Dompe after his abduction, and that he could not remember the abduction of journalist Poddala Jayant
